sections.Profile:
"Big Game," released by Stern Electronics in March 1980, is a widebody pinball machine designed by Harry Williams. Known for its unique safari theme, the game features four flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, five star rollovers, three banks of drop targets, two spinning targets, two stand-up targets, and one kick-out hole. This was Stern's first widebody game, although its playfield was narrower than typical widebody machines of the period.
